ValuationRuns.title: Inventory valuation and reconciliation
ValuationRuns.body:
Here inventory is valued, posted into the books and reconciled against the general ledger. A run: pick a cut-off, calculate, review the lines and the proposed adjusting entry, then post or reverse.

The report shows the authoritative valuation at a cut-off per control account, read straight from the engine.

The reconciliation sets sub-ledger against general ledger and names every difference. The period close runs the same check.
